behavior_changes.title: Validator settlement blocked on contribution rejection
behavior_changes.impact: Permanent stake lock on routine protocol operation
behavior_changes.description: settleValidator requires report.computed=true, but computeConsensus sets computed=true only on acceptance. Rejections leave validators with permanently locked stake.
behavior_changes.previous_behavior: Validators could always settle after consensus computation
behavior_changes.attack_vector: Contribute low-quality work to trigger rejection, validators lose stake
behavior_changes.economic_impact: Validators exit system, consensus quality degrades

behavior_changes.title: Escrow underflow in validator settlement
behavior_changes.description: settleValidator deducts validator rewards without checking escrow sufficiency. Multiple disputes can deplete escrow before settlements.
behavior_changes.new_behavior: No underflow protection in validator settlements
behavior_changes.attack_vector: Multiple disputes deplete escrow, validator settlements revert
behavior_changes.economic_impact: Validators lose access to earned rewards

removed_checks.title: Share transfer locks bypassed
removed_checks.description: StakeVault inherits ERC4626 but doesn't override _update(), allowing share transfers that bypass contributor/validator locks.

evidence.code: _burnShares reverts if user transferred shares away

removed_checks.previous_behavior: Share transfers blocked if they would violate locks
removed_checks.new_behavior: Free share transfers bypass all lock mechanisms
removed_checks.attack_vector: Transfer shares to fresh address, redeem full balance, leave locked account with no shares
removed_checks.economic_impact: Slashing permanently bricked, all stake operations fail

removed_checks.title: Zero hash commit bypass
removed_checks.description: bytes32(0) commit hash bypasses duplicate prevention, allowing infinite zero-stake commits that block validation.
removed_checks.previous_behavior: Zero hash properly rejected as invalid commit
removed_checks.attack_vector: Commit with bytes32(0), repeat to fill slots, block legitimate validation

new_externals.title: Pluggable consensus algorithm
new_externals.description: ConsensusAlgorithm address stored but ConsensusLib.calculate() called directly. Pluggable feature exists in storage but not implemented.
new_externals.risk: Dead code creates confusion, potential for incorrect implementation if enabled

new_externals.title: Validation adapter fees
new_externals.description: validationFeeBps configured but validationAdapter mapping never populated. Fee logic exists but cannot be charged.
new_externals.risk: Escrow accounting inconsistency when feature enabled

consensus_risks.title: Consensus settlement not nonce-keyed
consensus_risks.description: ValidatorConsensusResult keyed by (projectId, index, validator) not by nonce. Rejected contributions cannot be resubmitted at same index.
consensus_risks.risk: Validators cannot participate in resubmissions at same index

economic_security_gaps.title: Zero minimum validation stake
economic_security_gaps.description: Zero-stake validations allowed, undermining economic security model. ConsensusLib gives weight=1 to zero-stake validators.

economic_security_gaps.title: No validator capacity unlock path
economic_security_gaps.description: setValidatorCapacity only locks stake. No function to reduce validator commitment.

evidence.code: function unlockValidatorCapacity(address user, uint256 amount) external onlyRole(ENGINE_ROLE)

economic_security_gaps.risk: Validators cannot reduce commitment or exit

risk_assessment.deployment_risk: HIGH - Multiple release blockers prevent safe deployment
risk_assessment.economic_security: BROKEN - Share transfers bypass all locks, zero-stake validations allowed
risk_assessment.consensus_integrity: VULNERABLE - Multiple paths to consensus manipulation
risk_assessment.fund_safety: AT_RISK - Escrow underflows and permanent locks
risk_assessment.recommendation: DO NOT DEPLOY - Address all CRITICAL and HIGH severity regressions first
